snippet.title: Sumerian Six - Pre-Orders Start Trailer | PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S
snippet.description:
Sumerian Six is coming to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S!

Lead the Enigma Squad on a tactical stealth mission behind enemy lines in the shadows of WWII. Use experimental technology, tame the occult, and uncover ancient secrets.

📅 Releasing on March 6th
🎮 Pre-orders are now live on PlayStation and Xbox!

Pre-order on PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017461
Pre-order on Xbox: xbox.com/games/store/sumerian-six/9ND6NQ57WCPN
